The past 24 hours delivered major transfer shocks in European football, a gripping start to the Chinese Badminton Open, and continued NBA roster speculation across Chinese fan communities. - **Manchester United fans fury over ticket touting crackdown**: Supporters [told BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c2elxzrpw4eo) that anti-touting measures are hurting loyal matchgoers, with the club's 'ultimatum' fueling accusations of prioritizing profits over tradition.

**Watch next**: The UEFA Champions League qualifiers continue tonight, with several clubs facing do-or-die second legs.
